text: 到达六十岁之前，还有近二十年可以奉献自己、可以展现自己。
en: Before reaching sixty, there are nearly twenty years left in which to devote myself and to show myself.

text: 一个四十岁的离异女人带个孩子以后可怎么办？
en: What is a forty-year-old divorced woman with a child to do afterwards?

text: 如何好好活下去？
en: How to live on well?

text: 一、内因决定外因
en: I. Internal causes determine external causes

text: 做了16年婚姻咨询，帮助2万多名女性走出婚姻困境，我有一个深深的体会：
en: Having practised marriage counselling for 16 years and helped over 20,000 women out of their marital predicaments, I have a deep realisation:

text: 人一生的命运，其实根本不是由老天爷决定的。
en: A person's destiny throughout life is, in truth, not determined by Heaven at all.

text: 而是内因决定外因。
en: Rather, internal causes determine external causes.

text: 换句话说，就是心想事成。
en: In other words, it is that what the heart wishes, the mind achieves.

text: 咨询中，无论是被男人逼离，还是女人自己想要离婚，我时常会听到学员说下面3种话：
en: In counselling, whether a woman is pressured by a man into divorce or wants the divorce herself, I often hear clients say the following three kinds of remarks:

text: 1. 第一种：我一个中年女人离婚，还带着娃，经济上大滑坡，我不知道该怎么面对孩子， 未来也没有好男人会要我，我说不定会孤独终老，或者嫁给一个自己都看不上的男人，而且孩子的伤害我也不知道怎么弥补…
en: 1. The first kind: I am a middle-aged woman, divorced and still with a child, my finances have plummeted; I don't know how to face my child, and in future no good man will want me. I may well end up alone, or marry a man I don't even think much of, and I don't know how to make up for the harm done to my child…

text: 2. 第二种：虽然我知道现在离婚了，我要面对很多艰难困苦，但是我会想方设法地去解决。
en: 2. The second kind: although I know that now I am divorced I must face many hardships, I will find ways to resolve them.

text: 孩子我会想办法帮他渡过心理危机，这场婚姻的失败，让我认识到，其实感情中有很多规律是需要学习的，我相信，打不死我的，会让我更强大。
en: As for my child, I will find a way to help him through the psychological crisis. The failure of this marriage has made me realise that there are, in fact, many patterns in love that need to be learned. I believe that what does not kill me will make me stronger.

text: 3. 第三种：其实我本来对婚姻也就是那么回事，我早就过上“婚内单身”的生活了，我从来没觉得我需要个男人，他不过就是一个摆设，让我觉得自己还算正常。
en: 3. The third kind: truthfully, marriage was never much to me; I long ago began living a "single within marriage" life. I never felt I needed a man; he was merely an ornament, something that made me feel I was still normal.

text: 现在没有他，我觉得反而轻松了。
en: Now, without him, I actually feel more at ease.

text: 你看，第一种悲观失望的人，其实是有一个信仰，那就是：女人年龄愈大，就越贬值；女人离了男人活不了。
en: You see, the pessimistic and disappointed person of the first kind actually holds a belief, which is this: the older a woman grows, the more she depreciates; a woman cannot live without a man.

text: 有了这样的信仰，她的人生就是“不断叹气”。
en: With such a belief, her life becomes one of "constant sighing".

text: 比如，如果前夫回来找她，她就会叹口气说，算了，凑合过吧；
en: For example, if her ex-husband came back to her, she would sigh and say, forget it, let's just make do;

text: 如果她孤独时间久了，有个已婚男人撩拨她，她也会叹口气说，算了，我就享受一把恋爱的感觉吧；
en: if she has been lonely for a long time and a married man flirts with her, she would also sigh and say, forget it, I'll just enjoy the feeling of being in love;

text: 如果别人给她介绍个男人相亲，她也会叹口气说：算了，人到中年，要什么心动啊，人好就可以。
en: if someone introduces a man to her for a matchmaking meeting, she would sigh and say: forget it, at middle age what need is there for a flutter of the heart? A decent person will do.

text: 因为她相信自己“没救”，所以就用“凑合过”的态度面对人生所有选择，那她的日子能有希望吗？
en: Because she believes she is "beyond saving", she faces every choice in life with the attitude of "making do", so can her days hold any hope?

text: 没有，所以当她过上“越来越差”的日子的时候，她就会跟自己说：你看，我果然就是没好下场。
en: No. So when she lives "ever worse" days, she says to herself: you see, as expected, I came to no good end.

text: 这在心理学上叫做“自我验证”式的人生。
en: In psychology this is called a "self-verification" type of life.

text: 从这个角度上看，你信什么，就会根据你相信的，采取行动，反过来，你的行动又会导致一个结果，来验证你相信的东西。
en: From this angle, whatever you believe, you will, based on what you believe, take action; in turn, your action will lead to a result that verifies what you believe.

text: 同理，如果一个女人坚持有标准，有底线，有追求，有规划的人生，她的人生不会“叹气”而是会“憋一口气”，会坚持努力学习，努力成长，不断总结经验教训，因为她相信自己是“有救”的。
en: Likewise, if a woman persists in a life with standards, bottom lines, aspirations and plans, her life will not "sigh" but will "hold its breath", will persist in studying hard and growing, constantly summing up experience and lessons, because she believes she is "saveable".

text: 所以她不放弃自己，对自己足够认真，提升了3大格局，相应的，她的人生也会如她所愿。
en: So she does not give up on herself, takes herself seriously enough, raises her three major patterns, and correspondingly her life will be as she wishes.

text: 二、3大格局
en: II. Three major patterns

text: 第一大格局，从贬值公式进入升值公式。
en: The first major pattern: moving from the depreciation formula into the appreciation formula.

text: 我发现，大多数把自己的人生越过越差的人，往往都会有一种公式思维，她们试图把感情简化为一系列简单的等式，比如说：婚姻中只要能让，能忍，能努力，那最终这个男人会被我感动而变好的。
en: I have found that most people who live ever worse lives tend to have a formula mindset; they try to reduce love to a series of simple equations, for example: so long as in marriage one can yield, endure and strive, then in the end this man will be moved by me and become better.

text: 比如说，婚姻就是一地鸡毛，就是空虚无聊加寂寞，你要做的就是要放弃你那些不切实际的需要，学会躺平。
en: For example, marriage is just chicken feathers all over the floor, just emptiness, boredom and loneliness; what you must do is abandon those unrealistic needs of yours and learn to lie flat.

text: 简而言之
en: In short

text: 无穷付出+放弃需要=可以凑合的婚姻
en: Endless giving + abandoning needs = a marriage one can make do with

text: 但问题是，你能凑合男人未必愿意凑合，结果就是你被请出局了，然后你又要接受另一个公式，离婚的女人没有男人要，离异家庭出来的孩子一生都是悲剧。
en: But the problem is, you may make do, yet the man may not be willing to make do; the result is that you are shown the door, and then you must accept another formula: a divorced woman has no man who wants her, and a child from a divorced family is a tragedy for life.

text: 贬值+孩子受伤=更凑合的人生
en: Depreciation + a hurt child = an even more makeshift life

text: 结果女人就会进入到牺牲贬值贬值牺牲的无穷尽的恶性循环中。
en: As a result, the woman falls into the endless vicious cycle of sacrifice, depreciation, depreciation, sacrifice.

text: 为什么女人要进入到这样的格局中呢？
en: Why would a woman enter into such a pattern?

text: 因为这个格局的主要思想就是为了防守，就是为了信奉一个哲学，贬值哲学，你要不断的适应无穷尽的贬值的过程，你要做的就是不断的牺牲自己，来换取“更少一点的贬值”，而不是不贬值乃至升值。
en: Because the central idea of this pattern is to defend, is to believe in a philosophy—the philosophy of depreciation. You must constantly adapt to the endless process of depreciation; what you do is ceaselessly sacrifice yourself to trade for "a little less depreciation", rather than no depreciation or even appreciation.

text: 如果是这样，离婚其实是给了女人一个机会，那就是升值自己，从贬值哲学变为升值哲学。
en: If this is so, divorce actually gives a woman an opportunity, namely to appreciate herself, to shift from the philosophy of depreciation to the philosophy of appreciation.

text: 什么是升值哲学，就是我可以做什么让我得到更好的生活，而不是过上损失少一些的生活。
en: What is the philosophy of appreciation? It is asking what I can do to gain a better life, rather than to live one with somewhat fewer losses.

text: 第二大格局，做感情中最好的销售冠军
en: The second major pattern: be the best sales champion in love

text: 那具体怎么做呢，首先我们要明白。
en: Then how exactly to do this? First we must understand.

text: 到底是什么让一个女人在婚姻中贬值，不是容貌，不是年龄，不是金钱，是你对待自己的态度。
en: What exactly makes a woman depreciate in marriage is not looks, not age, not money—it is your attitude towards yourself.

text: 女人自我贬值，才会让男人对你贬值。
en: Only when a woman depreciates herself will the man depreciate her.

text: 我常在咨询中经常听到女人说：我没办法。
en: I often, in counselling, hear women say: I can't help it.

text: 我说你是有办法的，只是你不敢用。
en: I say you do have a way, only you dare not use it.

text: 比如说为什么每次都是女人要牺牲，来去满足男人的需求？
en: For example, why is it always the woman who must sacrifice, to satisfy the man's needs?

text: 为什么男人可以在外面应酬，而牺牲了女人的休息时间？
en: Why can a man socialise outside, at the cost of the woman's rest time?

text: 为什么女人在心中认为如果我不妥协这个关系就会被破坏？
en: Why does a woman believe in her heart that if she does not compromise, the relationship will be destroyed?

text: 我受不了这种下场，所以我要更妥协。
en: I cannot bear such an outcome, so I must compromise more.

text: 但是你这么想的时候已经是在告诉男人我更需要这个关系，你不需要这个关系，所以我会牺牲而不配让你为我付出更多。
en: But the moment you think this way, you are already telling the man that I need this relationship more, that you do not need it, and so I will sacrifice and do not deserve for you to give more for me.

text: 和男人相比，女人在感情中最吃亏的就是不知道该如何为自己讲价，她不知道男人是在用市场经济的方式对待感情，她更不知道男人的一句话就可以让女人迅速贬值。
en: Compared with men, what women lose out on most in love is not knowing how to bargain for themselves; she does not know that men treat love by means of a market economy, and she knows even less that a single word from a man can make a woman depreciate rapidly.

text: 比如男人说我想吃红烧肉了，女人马上说好的，我马上给你做，女人以为这是爱的表现，但她不知道这种单向的付出会让男人更加不珍惜。
en: For example, the man says I fancy some braised pork, and the woman immediately says all right, I'll make it for you at once; the woman thinks this is a show of love, but she does not know that such one-way giving makes the man cherish her even less.

text: 那女人该怎么说？
en: Then what should the woman say?

text: 她可以说：你想吃红烧肉为什么跟我说呢？
en: She can say: if you fancy braised pork, why tell me?

text: 男人说：因为我想让你做啊~
en: The man says: because I want you to make it~

text: 女人说：那我有什么好处呢？
en: The woman says: then what's in it for me?

text: 男人说：我会更爱你的啊！
en: The man says: I'll love you even more!

text: 女人说：那你求我！
en: The woman says: then beg me!

text: 男人说：求求好老婆~
en: The man says: please, good wife~

text: 女人说：再多说两次~
en: The woman says: say it two more times~

text: 男人说：谢谢老婆大人，谢谢老婆大人~
en: The man says: thank you, my lady wife, thank you, my lady wife~

text: 你看这个打情骂俏的过程其实就是在向男人强调一件事：
en: You see, this process of flirting and bantering is, in truth, impressing upon the man one thing:

text: 我很贵→你要珍惜
en: I am precious → you must treasure me

text: 我很美→你要赞美
en: I am beautiful → you must praise me

text: 真正聪明的女人永远都是感情的销售冠军，收割的是男人的情感付出，没有这种能力。
en: A truly clever woman is forever the sales champion of love, reaping the man's emotional devotion; without this ability,

text: 你才会慢慢失去了对男人的掌控。
en: you will slowly lose your hold over the man.

text: 第三大格局，如何真正的爱自己。
en: The third major pattern: how to truly love oneself.

text: 在咨询中，我经常发现很多女人对自己是很麻木的，她们在你面前哭，会一直努力的眨眼不让眼泪掉下来。
en: In counselling, I often find that many women are quite numb towards themselves; they weep before you, yet keep blinking hard to keep the tears from falling.

text: 如果掉下来，那就马上找纸巾擦掉，然后说对不起。
en: If they do fall, they at once reach for a tissue to wipe them away, then say sorry.

text: 我说那为什么你要说对不起呢，她说因为我失态了，我说为什么你不能失态呢，她说因为我不愿意成为别人的累赘，我说你看，那个婚外的女人那么失态，为什么你老公反而会魂牵梦绕呢，有没有可能就是因为她的失态，反而让人家怜香惜玉，而你处处要强，处处装着没事儿人，把眼泪往心理咽，反而让男人忽略了你是一个活生生的人呢？
en: I said then why do you say sorry? She said because I lost my composure. I said why can you not lose your composure? She said because I am unwilling to become a burden to others. I said look, that woman outside the marriage loses her composure so, so why does your husband instead brood over her day and night? Could it be precisely because her loss of composure makes him cherish and pity her, while you, putting on a strong front everywhere and pretending all is well, swallow your tears inwardly, instead make the man overlook that you are a living, breathing person?

text: 后来我才知道，这个女人从小就处在不能流泪的世界里，她目睹了妈妈是如何的软弱无力，如何经常的崩溃被爸爸嫌弃。
en: Only later did I learn that this woman grew up in a world where one could not cry; she witnessed how powerless and helpless her mother was, how often she broke down and was despised by her father.

text: 她就立志不能像她妈妈那样无能，绝对不要别人看到她的脆弱，被人当累赘，但这恰恰让她和老公在感情中没办法真正的亲密，让这份爱慢慢失去了活力。
en: So she resolved never to be as incapable as her mother, and absolutely would not let others see her vulnerability or be treated as a burden; yet this very thing prevented her and her husband from becoming truly intimate in their love, and let this love slowly lose its vitality.

text: 所以真实对自己的爱，是学会共情自己，我们绝大多数的人，是不太会真正的心疼自己，而当我们在咨询中拥有了这种能力以后，就会发现，自己变得格外有力量，格外的强大。
en: So genuine love for oneself is learning to empathise with oneself. The vast majority of us are not very good at truly feeling for ourselves; yet once we gain this ability in counselling, we find ourselves becoming exceptionally strong and exceptionally powerful.

text: 这个世界上本来有路，你闭上眼以后就没了路，睁开眼你会发现，原来这个世界没有你想象的那么糟，因为你把左右向外求助的力量都放回到自己身上。
en: This world originally had paths; once you close your eyes the paths are gone, but open your eyes and you will find that the world is not as bad as you imagined, because you have returned all the strength you formerly sought outside to yourself.

text: 第四大格局，给自己一个幸福的机会
en: The fourth major pattern: give oneself a chance of happiness

text: 有人说，如果你能找到一种自信，无论生命给我们是怎样的负面体验，只要给我一点时间，我总能把它转化为礼物和成长那你一定会拥有真正的幸福。
en: Someone said that if you can find a kind of confidence—whatever negative experience life gives us, so long as you give me a little time, I can always turn it into a gift and growth—then you will surely possess true happiness.

text: 我做的工作，就是尽可能地帮助你，明白，其实人生是有很多个选择的，
en: The work I do is to help you, as much as possible, understand that life in fact holds many choices,

text: 你需要走出自己的幻想，走出自己罗织的虚拟的世界。
en: and you need to step out of your own fantasy, out of the illusory world you yourself have woven.

text: 这个世界没有那么美好，也绝对不是悲剧。
en: This world is not so wonderful, yet absolutely not a tragedy.

text: 这个世界其实是由你定义的，如果你觉得人生只有一种选择，你完全对命运手足无措，我告诉你，你一定是活在噩梦里，此时你要做的，就是睁开眼，我让你看到真实世界的时候，你就会明白，这个世界很宽广，而你的人生无论到多大的岁数，都是有全新的选择。
en: This world is in fact defined by you. If you feel life has but one choice and you are utterly at a loss before fate, I tell you, you must be living in a nightmare; what you must do then is open your eyes, and when I let you see the real world, you will understand that this world is vast, and that your life, no matter how old you grow, always has brand-new choices.

text: 人生最可怕的，不是悲剧。
en: The most frightening thing in life is not tragedy.

text: 而是你从来没有给自己一个幸福的机会。
en: It is that you have never given yourself a chance of happiness.

text: 我是 @婚恋专家赵悦辰 中科院心理研究所心理学硕士、国家二级心理咨询师、婚恋关系咨询专家、心之助心理情感平台联合创始人、央视电台北京电台特邀心理专家，16年来帮助2万多名来访解决问题。
en: I am @ marriage-and-love expert Yuechen Zhao, Master of Psychology from the Institute of Psychology of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, National Level 2 Psychological Counsellor, marriage-and-love relationship counselling expert, co-founder of the Xinzhizhu psychology and emotion platform, invited psychological expert for CCTV Radio and Beijing Radio; over the past 16 years I have helped more than 20,000 clients resolve their problems.

text: 有情感问题问我，有问必答。
en: If you have emotional problems, ask me; I answer every question.
